# CMU 15-799: Special Topics in Databases - Query Optimization

> > Carnegie Mellon University graduate course on advanced database query optimization techniques, covering physical query plans, cost models, and adaptive optimization strategies.

This course is taught by Andy Pavlo and Wan Shen Lim at CMU, focusing on the theory and practice of query optimization in modern database systems. Students explore both classical and cutting-edge optimization techniques through lectures, readings, and open-source projects.

## Key Topics

- Query Optimization
- Database Systems
- Physical Query Plans
- Cost Models
- Adaptive Optimization
- SQL
- Carnegie Mellon University (CMU)
- Andy Pavlo
- Wan Shen Lim
- Graduate-Level Database Course
- Open Source Database Projects
- Query Execution
- Database Performance
- Optimizer Architecture
